# libutf source record

`kernel/utflib.cpp` and the UTF declarations in `include/proto.hpp` are derived
from suckless libutf, a small UTF-8 library under the MIT/X Consortium License.

- Upstream project: <https://oldgit.suckless.org/libutf/>
